description: A Node.js application that enables programmatic task tracking in Notion using the Notion API

functional_requirements.description: System must create new tasks in a Notion database with title, assignee, status, and notes
System must update existing task status and notes using page ID
System must authenticate with Notion API using API key
System must support environment-based configuration for API credentials and database ID
System must handle and log errors during API operations

non_functional_requirements.description: API keys must be stored in environment variables, not hardcoded
Functions must be exportable for reuse in other modules
System must provide console logging for successful operations and errors

ambiguous_requirements.context: Code sets ID to null expecting Notion auto-increment, but Notion database schema not documented
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Verify Notion database has proper ID field configuration

ambiguous_requirements.context: createTask accepts assignedTo parameter but sets people array to empty
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Clarify if assignee should be stored or if field should be removed

ambiguous_requirements.context: Code uses 'To-do' and 'Done' but full status taxonomy not defined
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Document all valid status values for the Notion database

ambiguous_requirements.context: main() function demonstrates usage but runs immediately when imported
ambiguous_requirements.recommendation: Separate example usage from production module
